t: This is India House on the Aldwych, home of the High Commission of India, the diplomatic mission of India in the United Kingdom. It sits between Bush House, Marconi House and Australia House, facing both the London School of Economics and King's College London. The building has been Grade Two listed since 1981. It was designed by Herbert Baker, an English architect remembered above all for South Africa, where he developed a neo-classical style meant to project imperial strength and permanence. In his day, he was the most prominent and prolific architect of his generation.
